title: Spanish PM Sanchez says Israel and Russia spread disinformation on Ceuta migrant crisis
summary: Centre-left Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Monday alleged that social networks linked to Israel and Russia had spread disinformation about the July migrant crisis in the Spanish exclave of Ceuta.
